cond_0001.intro: The Manufacturing Engineer will develop and improve production processes by observing and improving manufacturing methods. This will be a hands-on role where the employee will learn multiple different metal manufacturing processes on the job.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Read and understand product drawings/schematics from our engineers. Lead problem solving efforts to resolve production problems. Communicate with our quality and engineering teams to drive process improvements. Develop proper manufacturing, testing, and quality control standard work. Conduct in process checks on the production line to ensure standard work is followed and work-in-process, finished products, and packing meet quality requirements. Conduct final inspection on finished products and record test data. Develop and improve monthly reports to quantify Production improvement and identify areas requiring attention/improvement. Determine the process capabilities and outgoing quality levels of all major products. Identify process improvement and optimization opportunities. Assist in the development and implementation of training programs, process planning, and policies.

Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
2+ Years in production or process engineering/experience in a manufacturing environment
Knowledge and understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles, techniques, and philosophies
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a dynamic environment, developing flexible solutions to meet evolving business needs
Experience with LCD, VFD, OLED or TFT display technologies

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and how to improve them.
cond_0607.responsibilities: Read and understand product drawings/schematics from our engineers. Lead problem solving efforts to resolve production problems. Communicate with our quality and engineering teams to drive process improvements. Develop proper manufacturing, testing, and quality control standard work. Conduct in process checks on the production line to ensure standard work is followed and work-in-process, finished products, and packing meet quality requirements. Conduct final inspection on finished products and record test data. Develop and improve monthly reports to quantify Production improvement and identify areas requiring attention/improvement. Determine the process capabilities and outgoing quality levels of all major products. Identify process improvement and optimization opportunities. Assist in the development and implementation of training programs, process planning, and policies.
cond_0607.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
2+ Years in production or process engineering/experience in a manufacturing environment
Knowledge and understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles, techniques, and philosophies
Experience working in a dynamic environment, developing flexible solutions to meet evolving business needs
Experience with LCD, VFD, OLED or TFT display technologies is a plus
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
